Metro Atlanta Multi-Trade Company

You're looking for a reliable multi-trade company in Metro Atlanta to handle your home services needs. On this site, you can find information about Build Heritage, a licensed and insured Georgia contractor serving metro Atlanta and Georgia, and get a free, written, and itemized quote for your project.

How it Works for Homeowners in Metro Atlanta

Build Heritage offers 8 trades, including painting, drywall, flooring, and roofing, to help you with your home renovation or maintenance project. You can contact them through the quote form or email info@buildheritage.org to get a response within one business day. They serve areas such as Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, and Roswell, among others.

What You Get and What it Costs

The cost of services varies, but you can expect to pay between $9,000-$20,000 for a full roof replacement and $3,000-$8,000 for a whole-home interior repaint, according to the 2026 cost guide updated in August 2026. It's also recommended to hold back 10-15% on top of a quote for hidden issues.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? Build Heritage serves metro Atlanta and Georgia, including areas such as Atlanta, Marietta, and Alpharetta. How do I get a quote? You can contact Build Heritage through the quote form or email info@buildheritage.org to get a free, written, and itemized quote. What trades do you offer? Build Heritage offers 8 trades, including packing & moving, painting, drywall, flooring & vinyl, framing, doors, window & door trim, and roofing & tiles.
